captions.text: Shifts brings two kinds of scheduling into one place.
Recurring Group Shifts organizes people and required
roles across dated shift days.
Add Static Shift creates a separate fixed window for resources.
Start by identifying the work you need to coordinate.
In our fictional Chicago Fire department, we will create an assigned personnel
schedule, then a separate signup schedule.
Your Shifts, On Duty Now, Approvals and Shift Staffing are separate views.
A scheduled roster gives you recorded coverage; check current
operational information separately.
